items.title: 68239_Ram Ramirez oral history interview
items.q: Well, Carter, when he spoke of a malaise, he used the right word.

ctx.x: It's sad. And she became a sad singer of song.

But beyond sadness which you can take, there's something a bit sordid about it, I feel. You know, it's repellent to me. It's like a lot of people sort of had... There was a period, I think here, where a lot of people seemed to sort of have a death wish or something! Well, Carter, when he spoke of a malaise, he used the right word. I think there was a malaise in this nation. And all that sort of Billie Holiday cult of the later years seemed to me to be part of it! I didn't like it.

Well, to make an observation, it's too bad that Jimmy had to go to Paris. I mean, if he had been around more, I think a lot of things would have happened with him and I as far as writing is concerned.
